issues.description: The problem statement specifies that only EAX may be modified by set_pixel. While the code preserves other registers, it explicitly sets EAX to 1 as a return code. This contradicts the instruction that the register contents (except EAX as a workspace) should be handled according to the spec, and implies a functional return value not mentioned in the requirements.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove 'mov eax, 1' before the 'ret' instruction in set_pixel to adhere to the procedure contract.
